about_the_game:
The team at Ouroboros proudly presents: Race of the Nine Worlds!

A fast-paced Sci-Fi arcade racer inspired by the adrenaline-fueled videogame and cartoon classics of the 2000s.
This is more than a race—it's a test of friendship, courage, and duty.

A High-Speed Journey Across the Stars

In a future where distant worlds are connected by mysterious Paths and nine nations wage an implacable war against each other, the appearance of a divine being – the Great Serpent – ​​changes everything. He announces the beginning of a great trial:

The Race of the Nine Worlds.

Nine champions.

One winner.

The prize? Control over the Paths and the power to change the fate of the universe.

Meet Balt, a Hero in the Making

Enter Balt, a daring young fox from the Rinki tribe, whose childhood dreams of racing among the stars are suddenly within reach. With powerful rivals, dangerous tracks, and mysterious forces at play, Balt must navigate more than just sharp turns if he hopes to win.

Become a Path Racer

Unlock all nine champions, each with a distinct vehicle, playstyle, and game-changing Ultimate Ability. Master them to dominate the track.

Create Chaos with Serpent Seals

Use Serpent Seals to activate unpredictable track events. Play smart—or suffer the consequences.

Race with Friends

Test your champions in races against other players!

The Great Serpent has called. The Race has begun.

Will you rise to become the champion who changes everything?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 2600 @ 3.4 GHz / Intel® Core™ I5-8400 @ 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1050 TI 4 Gb / Radeon RX 570 8 Gb
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound card compatible with DirectX® 9.0с
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Ryzen 7 5800x @ 3.8 GHz / Intel® Core™ i5-10600 @ 4.1 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce RTX 2060 Super 8 Gb / Radeon RX 5700 XT 8 Gb
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound card compatible with DirectX® 9.0с

short_description: Take part in the Race of Nine Worlds! Play as one of the nine Path Racers, rush through the tracks of fantastic planets, go through an exciting story campaign and become a legend who will restore peace among the warring galaxies.
supported_languages:
English*, Russian
*languages with full audio support
